variants.name: 居中卡片
variants.copy: Screen state: redemption FORM before redemption, with a code field showing its example placeholder. Most prominent text "兑换测评", followed by "输入兑换码，领取你的测评". Show a compact product summary "伴侣协作体检" with the three metadata chips. One clear field label "兑换码"; long single-line input placeholder "DEMO-XXXX-XXXX"; trailing small clipboard action "粘贴". Helper text "在购买平台获取兑换码后，回到这里兑换". Lavender primary button "确认兑换". Small support links "兑换码在哪里？" and "联系客服". Quiet note "无需登录，也能兑换与查看报告". A back action "返回商品详情". Use only these necessary texts; no pre-redemption 开始测评 action. No successful check or results on this form.
variants.layout: Layout variant 01 — centered focused redemption card within the main content area, occupying about 640px x 560px, with spacious dark margins. Breadcrumb "应用商城 / 兑换测评" and back link above. Card top has a small lavender ticket outline emblem, title and subtitle left-aligned. A horizontal compact product summary with a 76px lavender ribbon thumbnail sits above the input. Full-width input, then full-width lavender primary action, then quiet helper links aligned left and right. A subtle help box below. Main viewport background stays dark and uncluttered. This is a dedicated full web page, not a modal.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity Chinese desktop web UI design concept for the established MeetMyWorld assessment marketplace.
